description: KSAB5's booth: a small dark room built round a wall of screens. A big one in the middle, a tall one either side, a ticker running under them and the station's name along the top. A presenter stands at the wall on a taped mark, and an anchor desk sits on a lit riser to one side. The floor is black gloss with a ring let into it. The studio is through the west door.
name: KSAB5 Booth
